properties.name: spring.groovy.template.allow-request-override
properties.description: Whether HttpServletRequest attributes are allowed to override (hide) controller generated model attributes of the same name.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.allow-session-override
properties.description: Whether HttpSession attributes are allowed to override (hide) controller generated model attributes of the same name.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.auto-escape
properties.description: Whether models that are assignable to CharSequence are escaped automatically.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.auto-indent
properties.description: Whether indents are rendered automatically.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.auto-indent-string
properties.description: String used for auto-indents.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.auto-new-line
properties.description: Whether new lines are rendered automatically.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.base-template-class
properties.description: Template base class.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.cache
properties.description: Whether to enable template caching.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.charset
properties.description: Template encoding.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.check-template-location
properties.description: Whether to check that the templates location exists.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.content-type
properties.description: Content-Type value.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.declaration-encoding
properties.description: Encoding used to write the declaration heading.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.expand-empty-elements
properties.description: Whether elements without a body should be written expanded (<br></br>) or not (<br/>).

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.expose-request-attributes
properties.description: Whether all request attributes should be added to the model prior to merging with the template.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.expose-session-attributes
properties.description: Whether all HttpSession attributes should be added to the model prior to merging with the template.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.expose-spring-macro-helpers
properties.description: Whether to expose a RequestContext for use by Spring's macro library, under the name "springMacroRequestContext".

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.locale
properties.description: Default locale for template resolution.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.new-line-string
properties.description: String used to write a new line. Defaults to the system's line separator.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.prefix
properties.description: Prefix that gets prepended to view names when building a URL.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.request-context-attribute
properties.description: Name of the RequestContext attribute for all views.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.resource-loader-path
properties.description: Template path.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.suffix
properties.description: Suffix that gets appended to view names when building a URL.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.use-double-quotes
properties.description: Whether attributes should use double quotes.

properties.name: spring.groovy.template.view-names
properties.description: View names that can be resolved.

deprecation.reason: No longer required. To use Groovy Templates without auto-configuration, depend directly on Groovy Templates instead of spring-boot-groovy-templates.
